'''Pell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] pilot and a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]] in [[3640 BBY]] Pell's starfighter crashed on the [[Road to Glory]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]'s [[Eastern Ice Shelf]]. Pell sent his astromech droid [[L4-B5]] to the [[Republic base camp]], where the droid convinced a Republic citizen to find the wreckage of their starfighter and provide Pell with medical aid.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Pell appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the mission "Pilot Down."
